content: उपशम् €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To become calm or quiet, be assuaged; उपशाम्यतु ते बुद्धिः <ls>Bk. 20. 5</ls>. .²2 To cease, stop; अग्निः, शब्दः, कोपः <ab>&c.</ab>; cease to speak; <ls>K. 110</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To calm, tranquillize. .²2 To appease, pacify, assuage, mitigate. .²3 To extinguish, kill.
